name: Hojicha
description: Green tea roasted brown — nutty, low in caffeine, and given to children at night.

tcm.note: Roasting turns a cool tea neutral, which is why it is an evening drink.

ayurveda.note: Outside the classical record; roasting is ushna; the leaf beneath is shita.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; roasted, so drying.

stimulant.note: Roasted, which drives off some of the caffeine. The gentlest of the green teas for that reason.

guna.note: Stimulating, which is the definition of rajasic rather than a judgement on it.

effects.note: Trials pairing L-theanine with caffeine report calmer, steadier attention than caffeine alone — the doses studied run supplement-strength, above what one cup delivers. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
